patches.decision_note: Breaking up text-heavy articles with images, quotes, or blurbs is independently testable from eliminating empty areas at article endings. Rerun extraction for both Requirements.

requirements.title: Advertisement Trim, Bleed, and Safe Placement

patches.decision_note: Advertisement clarity and resolution can fail or be repaired independently of trim, bleed, sizing, and safe-zone placement. Rerun extraction for both Requirements.

replacement.title: Print-Ready Magazine PDF
replacement.definition: Deliver a physical-print-ready magazine output with the required prepress preparation when the print deliverable remains in scope.

patches.decision_note: The print-ready output is an independent deliverable with its own removal and conditional-scope history and must not be represented under the launch deadline.

replacement.title: Accurate Table of Contents
replacement.definition: Complete the table of contents after pagination is finalized and ensure its article references and page numbers are accurate.

patches.decision_note: Table-of-contents accuracy is explicitly requested and can fail independently of cover references and general pagination.

replacement.title: Website Article Sourcing
replacement.definition: Gather the issue's articles directly from the WB Edition website as instructed by the client.

patches.decision_note: Direct website sourcing is an explicit task-local obligation and is not equivalent to verifying that all required issue content was ultimately included.
This message requires adding cover-listed articles to the issue and choosing their placement; it does not establish an incorrect cover reference requiring correction.

value_updates.cover_page_references: The page numbers displayed with cover-listed articles must match the articles' final page locations.
